dataset.title: Raw data of journal paper of Effects of Mineralisation on the Hierarchical Organisation of Collagen - a Synchrotron X-ray Scattering and Polarised Second Harmonic Generation Study
dataset.acquisition_family: polarization-resolved second harmonic generation microscopy with a synchrotron X-ray scattering reference

split.algorithm: sha256(salt + '|' + sample_id), ascending; first two development, remaining two confirmation

allowed: download and inspect Sample1 and Sample3 MAT schemas
identify the image arrays, dimensions, physical calibration and deposited reference variables
develop import, unit tests, QC and candidate endpoint definitions using Sample1 and Sample3 only
read the publication and repository metadata
prohibited_until_locked_protocol: opening or summarizing any Sample2 or Sample4 MAT array
selecting thresholds or endpoints using Sample2 or Sample4
reporting confirmation performance before an immutable locked protocol exists

claim_boundary: This prelock authorizes development only and contains no positive performance claim.
The four specimens are independent units; pixels, tiles and zones must not be treated as independent specimens.
The X-ray data are an orthogonal structural reference but are not assumed to be perfectly registered to pSHG pixels.
A confirmation result on two specimens would be a compact external-acquisition transfer test, not population validation, mechanics validation or clinical validation.
